applies_to: Price PIC-SD controllers on single-duct VAV terminals.
summary: The PIC-SD is the single-duct VAV member of Price's PIC family, with BACnet MS/TP and VAV airflow sensing built in. Its object list is shorter than the PIC's (two analog and two binary outputs, two spare voltage inputs). Instance numbers differ from the PIC for the same functions, so don't reuse a PIC template unchanged.
notes: The source prints AO1 and AO2 a second time against Airflow Target and Room Setpoint - High Limit. AO 1/AO 2 are already the analog outputs, the setpoint ranges refer to AV2/AV3 and the PIC lists the same points as AV 1/AV 2, so they are listed here as AV 1 and AV 2. Check on the device.
Only one low-temperature alarm threshold is listed (AV 24, Level 2); there is no Level 3 low-temperature threshold object.
MV 2 Occupancy uses 1 = Occupied, 2 = Unoccupied, the reverse of the PIC.
AI 6 and AI 7 (named AI1 and AI2) are the spare voltage inputs.
Same family as the PIC (Price Intelligent Controller) but a separate, shorter object list.

integration.summary: Set a unique MAC and device instance at the thermostat, set the segment baud (Price default 76800), then map the occupancy override, room setpoint, room temperature, airflow and the alarm-level MVs. The controller runs its own airflow and reheat sequence; the BMS mostly adjusts setpoints and occupancy.

minimum_points.why: Low room temp alarm level (5 = no alarm)

minimum_points.why: Low airflow alarm level (5 = no alarm)

integration.enable: No enable point. Occupancy comes from airflow, a contact closure, the thermostat button or a motion sensor; the BMS can force it with MV 4 Occupancy Override (1 = No Override, 2 = Force Unoccupied, 3 = Force Occupied). MV 3 shows what set the current occupancy.
setup: BACnet MS/TP is built into the PIC-SD.
Price's PIC manual gives 76800 as the default baud for Price products (9600, 19200 and 38400 also available). All devices on a segment must match.
MAC address (AV 30, default 1, range 1-127) and device instance (AV 29, default 101) are writable objects.
MV 14 MAC/DI Link (default Linked) ties the device instance to the MAC address.
gotchas: Alarm MVs report a level (1-4) or 5 = No Alarm; levels follow the AV alarm-threshold settings.
Room setpoint writes are limited by the high/low limit AVs.
Temperature objects follow the Temperature Units setting (°F or °C).
